rationale: The assistant quickly identified the missing high loop after the sink replacement, which was the correct cause, and guided a free DIY fix that the customer confirmed worked. It used US-centric language (garbage disposal, local code, air gap) that is less suited to a UK homeowner, and it asked no direct question about timing relative to sink use. It mentioned a faulty non-return valve only as a fallback possibility, not as a recommendation, so no part was recommended.
